Introduction

LOVEONE is a four member girl group under CMG Stars. They made their debut on November 22, 2024 with the single album "Funny Honey".

The lineup consists of ex ViV's member Yume, Yousom, Yuna, and Ayeon.

On July 7, it was announced that Chaei has departed from LOVEONE after the mutual termination and withdrawal of her exclusive contract with the agency due to personal reasons. The group would continue to move forward as four-member group.
